items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 May 2026 5:35am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 20 May 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure northwest of Ireland, moving eastwards, with associated fronts and troughs affecting Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, backing southwest 5 or 6 this morning, decreasing 4 or 5 early in the afternoon, increasing 5 or 6 again overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain at first, then mainly fair. Further rain overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain at first, then a risk of mist and fog patches.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain at first, poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches.
